## About
JMB Plumbing & Construction is a family-owned plumbing, remodeling and construction company based on E McGlincy Ln in Campbell. We work with residential and commercial customers across San Jose and the greater Silicon Valley.
Our work runs from fixing a leaky faucet or replacing a water heater to bathroom and kitchen remodels, heating and air conditioning, and home additions. We keep you informed at every stage, so you know what to expect.
One Google reviewer who had a master bathroom remodeled wrote that our crew put up plastic barriers and canvas tarps, and cleaned up after themselves every day.

## Services
- Emergency plumbing and water damage: Prompt help for plumbing problems that can't wait, including rapid response for water damage.
- Copper pipes replacement: Replacing old pipes with copper. One reviewer said they now get hot water faster than before.
- Water heater repair and replacement: Repairing or replacing the water heater in your home.
- Sewer and storm drain work: Hydro flash cleaning for storm drain and sewer pipes.
- Full bathroom renovations: Taking your bathroom down to the studs and building it back the way you want it.
- Kitchen remodels: Kitchen remodels planned and built by the same family team that handles your plumbing.
- Heating and air conditioning: Heating and air conditioning work for your home.
- Home additions: Full design and build when your home needs more room.

## FAQ
Q: What do I do if I have a plumbing emergency?
A: Call our emergency line at (408) 591-3324.

Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Reach out about your problem or project and ask for a free estimate.

Q: What is your contractor license number?
A: Our contractor license number is 698981.

They make every effort to avoid creating messes (like putting up plastic barriers and canvas tarps to protect and cover surfaces).  And they clean up after themselves every day, and make sure they don't leave a mess anywhere on the property.
